premises.text: Professionals often forget to bill calls made on their mobile phones, leading to significant financial losses.
premises.evidence_span: roughly 40% of the time professionals that bill by the hour spend talking on a mobile phone goes unbilled

premises.text: A mobile app can simplify the billing process for calls by automatically tracking them.
premises.evidence_span: our app automatically starts tracking that call for billing

premises.text: There is a significant market for mobile billing solutions among professionals who bill for call time.
premises.evidence_span: Billzai is a mobile billing solution for attorneys, consultants, life coaches, and anyone that bills for call time with clients on their mobile phone

value.text: Professionals can recover lost revenue by efficiently billing for mobile calls.
value.evidence_span: one 15-minute missed call a day equals 20,000 a year

notes: Download and user metrics excluded as traction.
